typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	BUS_FILE as string (),
	BUS_PATH as string (),
	BUS_PATH_FINAL as string (),
	DateTime as string (),
	Email_CC as string (),
	Email_From as string (),
	Email_To as string (),
	Excel_Name_final as string (),
	Excel_Path as string (),
	Filename as string (),
	Instance_Name as string (),
	ORA_Password as string (),
	ORA_Server as string (),
	ORA_Username as string (),
	SMTP_Connection as string (),
	Table_data_Summary as string (),
	V_ERR_EXISTS as integer ()
}

source(output(
		SBSB_ID as string,
		SBSB_CK as integer,
		MEME_HICN as string,
		GRGR_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT DISTINCT SBSB_ID,SBSB_CK,MEME_HICN,GRGR_ID FROM AGP.BFI_LIS_DEL_RECORD WHERE CURR_STATUS=\'I\'',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive({Copy of SBSB_CK} = toString(SBSB_CK),
		{Copy of MEME_HICN} = toString(MEME_HICN),
		{Copy of SBSB_ID} = toString(SBSB_ID),
		{Copy of GRGR_ID} = toString(GRGR_ID)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		{Copy of GRGR_ID} as string,
		{Copy of SBSB_ID} as string,
		{Copy of MEME_HICN} as string,
		{Copy of SBSB_CK} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ExcelDestination
